104.hindi_meaning: एक रासायनिक अभिक्रिया जिसमें एक ही पदार्थ का ऑक्सीकरण और अपचयन एक साथ होता है।
104.example: The Cannizzaro reaction is a classic example of disproportionation.

104.english_meaning: A solution containing a large amount of solute in a relatively small amount of solvent.
104.hindi_meaning: सांद्र; वह घोल जिसमें विलायक की तुलना में विलेय की मात्रा अधिक हो।
104.example: The reaction requires concentrated alkali to proceed.

104.english_meaning: A basic, ionic salt of an alkali metal or alkaline earth metal element.
104.hindi_meaning: क्षार; एक क्षारीय पदार्थ जो पानी में घुलनशील होता है।
104.example: Concentrated alkali is used to catalyze the reaction.

104.english_meaning: An organic acid containing a carboxyl group (-COOH).
104.hindi_meaning: एक कार्बनिक अम्ल जिसमें कार्बोक्सिल समूह (-COOH) होता है।
104.example: The oxidation product of the aldehyde is a carboxylic acid salt.

104.english_meaning: The smallest unit of a chemical compound that can take part in a chemical reaction.
104.hindi_meaning: अणु; किसी रासायनिक यौगिक की सबसे छोटी इकाई जो रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में भाग ले सकती है।
104.example: One molecule of aldehyde is reduced to alcohol.

105.english_meaning: Relating to a chemical species that is attracted to electrons.
105.hindi_meaning: इलेक्ट्रॉन-स्नेही (जो इलेक्ट्रॉन की ओर आकर्षित हो)
105.example: The benzene ring undergoes electrophilic substitution in the presence of a catalyst.

105.english_meaning: A chemical reaction in which an atom or group of atoms is replaced by another.
105.hindi_meaning: प्रतिस्थापन (एक परमाणु या समूह का दूसरे द्वारा बदला जाना)
105.example: Electrophilic substitution is a common reaction in aromatic compounds.

105.english_meaning: Reducing the reactivity of a chemical group or ring.
105.hindi_meaning: निष्क्रिय करने वाला (अभिक्रियाशीलता को कम करने वाला)
105.example: The carbonyl group acts as a deactivating group in the aromatic ring.

105.english_meaning: Relating to a chemical species that donates an electron pair to form a bond.
105.hindi_meaning: नाभिक-स्नेही (जो नाभिक या धनावेश की ओर आकर्षित हो)
105.example: Aldehydes are generally more reactive than ketones in nucleophilic addition reactions.

105.english_meaning: The state or power of being reactive or the rate at which a chemical substance tends to undergo a chemical reaction.
105.hindi_meaning: अभिक्रियाशीलता (किसी पदार्थ के रासायनिक अभिक्रिया करने की क्षमता)
105.example: The reactivity of the compounds depends on their electronic structure.

105.english_meaning: Relating to the spatial arrangement of atoms in a molecule.
105.hindi_meaning: त्रिविम (अणुओं में परमाणुओं की स्थानिक व्यवस्था से संबंधित)
105.example: Steric effect plays a crucial role in determining the rate of addition reactions.

105.english_meaning: The production of chemical compounds by reaction from simpler materials.
105.hindi_meaning: संश्लेषण (सरल पदार्थों से जटिल यौगिकों का निर्माण)
105.example: Aldehydes are used as starting materials for the synthesis of various drugs.

105.english_meaning: Substances or compounds added to a system to cause a chemical reaction.
105.hindi_meaning: अभिकर्मक (रासायनिक अभिक्रिया कराने के लिए प्रयुक्त पदार्थ)
105.example: Many reagents are used in the laboratory to convert ketones into alcohols.

105.english_meaning: A 40% aqueous solution of formaldehyde used as a preservative.
105.example: Formalin is widely used in biology labs to preserve specimens.

105.english_meaning: Individual animals, plants, or pieces of matter used for scientific study.
105.hindi_meaning: नमूने (वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले जीव या पदार्थ)
105.example: The biological specimens were stored in formalin jars.

105.english_meaning: A synthetic plastic resin made from phenol and formaldehyde.
105.hindi_meaning: बेकेलाइट (एक प्रकार का कठोर प्लास्टिक रेजिन)
105.example: Bakelite is a phenol-formaldehyde resin used in electrical insulators.

105.english_meaning: Relating to a substance that has a molecular structure consisting chiefly or entirely of a large number of similar units bonded together.
105.hindi_meaning: बहुलकीय (अनेक इकाइयों से बनी लंबी श्रृंखला वाले पदार्थ)
105.example: Many polymeric products are derived from simple aldehydes.

105.english_meaning: To make something on a large scale using machinery.
105.hindi_meaning: निर्माण करना (बड़े पैमाने पर उत्पादन करना)
105.example: Acetaldehyde is used in the manufacture of acetic acid.

105.english_meaning: The craft or business of making perfumes.
105.hindi_meaning: सुगंध निर्माण उद्योग (इत्र बनाने का कार्य)
105.example: Benzaldehyde is highly valued in the perfumery industry for its pleasant scent.

105.english_meaning: Substances, usually liquids, capable of dissolving other substances.
105.hindi_meaning: विलायक (वे पदार्थ जिनमें अन्य पदार्थ घुल जाते हैं)
105.example: Acetone is one of the most common industrial solvents.

106.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing a carboxyl functional group (-COOH).
106.hindi_meaning: वे कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें कार्बोक्सिल कार्यात्मक समूह (-COOH) होता है।
106.example: Carboxylic acids are widely found in nature and organic compounds.

106.english_meaning: A specific group of atoms within molecules that is responsible for the characteristic chemical reactions of those molecules.
106.hindi_meaning: अणुओं के भीतर परमाणुओं का एक विशिष्ट समूह जो उनकी रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं के लिए उत्तरदायी होता है।
106.example: The carboxyl group is the functional group characteristic of organic acids.

106.english_meaning: A chemical group consisting of a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom (>C=O).
106.hindi_meaning: एक कार्बन परमाणु जो ऑक्सीजन परमाणु के साथ द्वि-आबंध (double bond) द्वारा जुड़ा होता है।
106.example: A carboxyl group consists of a carbonyl group attached to a hydroxyl group.

106.english_meaning: A chemical functional group consisting of a hydrogen atom bonded to an oxygen atom (-OH).
106.hindi_meaning: एक रासायनिक समूह जिसमें एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु ऑक्सीजन परमाणु से जुड़ा होता है (-OH)।
106.example: The hydroxyl group is an essential part of alcohols and carboxylic acids.

106.english_meaning: Relating to organic compounds in which carbon atoms are linked in open chains rather than aromatic rings.
106.hindi_meaning: वे कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें कार्बन परमाणु खुली श्रृंखलाओं में जुड़े होते हैं, वलय (rings) में नहीं।
106.example: Methane and acetic acid are examples of aliphatic compounds.

106.english_meaning: Relating to organic compounds containing planar conjugated ring systems with delocalized pi-electron clouds.
106.hindi_meaning: वे कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें बेंजीन रिंग जैसी समतलीय चक्रीय संरचना होती है।
106.example: Benzoic acid is a well-known aromatic carboxylic acid.

106.english_meaning: A univalent radical containing only carbon and hydrogen atoms arranged in a chain.
106.hindi_meaning: केवल कार्बन और हाइड्रोजन परमाणुओं से बना एक मूलक जो एल्केन से एक हाइड्रोजन हटाने पर बनता है।
106.example: An alkyl group is attached to the carboxylic carbon in aliphatic acids.

106.english_meaning: A functional group or radical derived from an aromatic ring, such as phenyl.
106.hindi_meaning: एरोमैटिक वलय से प्राप्त एक कार्यात्मक समूह या मूलक।
106.example: Aryl groups are derived from aromatic hydrocarbons by removing a hydrogen atom.

106.english_meaning: Organic acids with long aliphatic tails, which are found in natural fats and oils.
106.hindi_meaning: लंबी श्रृंखला वाले कार्बोक्सिलिक अम्ल जो प्राकृतिक वसा (fats) और तेलों में पाए जाते हैं।
106.example: Fatty acids occur in natural fats as esters of glycerol.

106.english_meaning: Chemical compounds derived from an acid in which at least one -OH group is replaced by an -O-alkyl group.
106.hindi_meaning: वे रासायनिक यौगिक जो अम्ल और अल्कोहल की प्रतिक्रिया से बनते हैं।
106.example: Glycerol esters of fatty acids are the main constituents of animal fats.

106.english_meaning: A simple sweet, viscous liquid, colorless and odorless, used in various chemical products.
106.hindi_meaning: एक मीठा, गाढ़ा और रंगहीन तरल पदार्थ जो प्राकृतिक वसा में पाया जाता है।
106.example: Fats are naturally occurring esters of glycerol and fatty acids.

106.english_meaning: Compounds formed by the removal of water molecules from an acid.
106.hindi_meaning: वे यौगिक जो किसी अम्ल से पानी के अणुओं को हटाने पर बनते हैं।
106.example: Carboxylic acids serve as starting material to prepare acid anhydrides.

106.english_meaning: Compounds containing the functional group with a carbonyl group linked to a nitrogen atom.
106.hindi_meaning: वे कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें कार्बोनिल समूह सीधे नाइट्रोजन परमाणु से जुड़ा होता है।
106.example: Amides are important derivatives of carboxylic acids.

106.english_meaning: The devised system of names used in a particular branch of science or art.
106.hindi_meaning: विज्ञान में किसी क्षेत्र विशेष के तत्वों या यौगिकों के नामकरण की प्रणाली।
106.example: The IUPAC nomenclature provides standardized rules for naming chemical compounds.

106.english_meaning: A morpheme added at the end of a word to form a derivative, such as '-oic acid'.
106.hindi_meaning: किसी शब्द के अंत में जोड़ा जाने वाला शब्दांश (प्रत्यय)।
106.example: In IUPAC system, the names of carboxylic acids end with the suffix '-oic acid'.

107.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing a functional group with the structure -CHO.
107.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें -CHO समूह होता है।
107.example: Aldehydes are easily oxidized to form carboxylic acids.

107.english_meaning: Organic compounds characterized by a carbonyl group bonded to two carbon atoms.
107.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें कार्बोनिल समूह दो कार्बन परमाणुओं से जुड़ा होता है।
107.example: Acetone is the simplest example of ketones.

107.english_meaning: Organic acids containing a carboxyl group (-COOH).
107.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक अम्ल जिनमें कार्बोक्सिल समूह (-COOH) होता है।
107.example: Acetic acid is a common carboxylic acid found in vinegar.

107.english_meaning: Having an affinity for electrons; attracted to electron-rich sites.
107.hindi_meaning: इलेक्ट्रॉन-स्नेही; जो इलेक्ट्रॉन की ओर आकर्षित होता है।
107.example: The carboxylic carbon is less electrophilic due to resonance.

107.english_meaning: A way of describing delocalized electrons within certain molecules.
107.hindi_meaning: अणुओं के भीतर इलेक्ट्रॉनों के विस्थानीकरण की प्रक्रिया।
107.example: Resonance structures explain the stability of the carboxyl group.

107.english_meaning: International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry; the standard for chemical nomenclature.
107.hindi_meaning: शुद्ध और अनुप्रयुक्त रसायन विज्ञान का अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संघ; रासायनिक नामकरण का मानक।
107.example: You must provide the IUPAC names for these chemical structures.

107.english_meaning: Chemically combined with oxygen or having lost electrons.
107.hindi_meaning: ऑक्सीकृत; ऑक्सीजन के साथ जुड़ना या इलेक्ट्रॉन खोना।
107.example: Primary alcohols are oxidised to form carboxylic acids.

107.english_meaning: A strong oxidizing agent with the chemical formula KMnO4.
107.hindi_meaning: एक शक्तिशाली ऑक्सीकारक जिसका रासायनिक सूत्र KMnO4 है।
107.example: Potassium permanganate is used in various laboratory oxidations.

107.english_meaning: Having the properties of a base; having a pH greater than 7.
107.hindi_meaning: क्षारीय; जिसका pH मान 7 से अधिक हो।
107.example: The reaction can occur in acidic or alkaline media.

107.english_meaning: A chemical compound containing the Cr2O7 ion.
107.hindi_meaning: एक रासायनिक यौगिक जिसमें Cr2O7 आयन होता है।
107.example: Potassium dichromate is a common oxidizing agent.

107.english_meaning: An inorganic compound with the formula CrO3, used as an oxidant.
107.hindi_meaning: एक अकार्बनिक यौगिक (CrO3) जिसका उपयोग ऑक्सीकारक के रूप में किया जाता है।
107.example: Chromium trioxide is a component of the Jones reagent.

107.english_meaning: A substance used in a chemical reaction to detect, measure, or produce other substances.
107.hindi_meaning: अभिकर्मक; रासायनिक अभिक्रिया में उपयोग होने वाला पदार्थ।
107.example: Jones reagent is specifically used for the oxidation of alcohols.

107.english_meaning: A functional group composed of a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom.
107.hindi_meaning: एक कार्यात्मक समूह जिसमें कार्बन परमाणु ऑक्सीजन के साथ द्वि-आबंध (double bond) से जुड़ा होता है।
107.example: The carbonyl group is central to the chemistry of aldehydes and ketones.

107.english_meaning: The environment or substance in which a chemical reaction takes place.
107.hindi_meaning: माध्यम; वह वातावरण या पदार्थ जिसमें रासायनिक अभिक्रिया होती है।
107.example: The reaction proceeds efficiently in acidic media.

107.english_meaning: The act of making or producing something.
107.hindi_meaning: तैयारी; किसी पदार्थ को बनाने की प्रक्रिया।
107.example: There are several methods for the preparation of carboxylic acids.

108.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing the functional group -COOH, known for their acidic properties.
108.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें -COOH समूह होता है, जो अपने अम्लीय गुणों के लिए जाने जाते हैं।
108.example: Carboxylic acids can be prepared from aldehydes by the use of mild oxidising agents.

108.english_meaning: A class of organic compounds containing a terminal carbonyl group bonded to a hydrogen atom.
108.hindi_meaning: एक प्रकार के कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु से जुड़ा हुआ टर्मिनल कार्बोनिल समूह होता है।
108.example: Carboxylic acids are also prepared from aldehydes by the use of mild oxidising agents.

108.english_meaning: Substances that tend to bring about oxidation by accepting electrons.
108.hindi_meaning: वे पदार्थ जो इलेक्ट्रॉन ग्रहण करके ऑक्सीकरण की प्रक्रिया को पूरा करते हैं (ऑक्सीकारक)।
108.example: Mild oxidising agents are used to convert aldehydes into carboxylic acids.

108.english_meaning: Organic compounds consisting of a benzene ring substituted with one or more alkyl groups.
108.hindi_meaning: एक या अधिक एल्काइल समूहों से प्रतिस्थापित बेंजीन वलय वाले कार्बनिक यौगिक।
108.example: Aromatic carboxylic acids can be prepared by vigorous oxidation of alkyl benzenes.

108.english_meaning: Characterized by force, energy, or intensity.
108.example: Aromatic carboxylic acids are prepared by vigorous oxidation using chromic acid.

108.english_meaning: A dark purple crystalline chemical compound used as a strong oxidizing agent.
108.hindi_meaning: एक गहरे बैंगनी रंग का क्रिस्टलीय रासायनिक यौगिक जो एक प्रबल ऑक्सीकारक के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है।
108.example: Alkyl benzenes can be oxidised using acidic or alkaline potassium permanganate.

108.english_meaning: Not taking (something) into consideration; regardless of.
108.hindi_meaning: के बावजूद, पर ध्यान दिए बिना।
108.example: The entire side chain is oxidised to the carboxyl group irrespective of length.

108.english_meaning: A functional group consisting of a carbon atom double-bonded to an oxygen atom and single-bonded to a hydroxyl group (-COOH).
108.hindi_meaning: एक कार्यात्मक समूह जिसमें एक कार्बन परमाणु ऑक्सीजन के साथ द्वि-आबंध और हाइड्रॉक्सिल समूह के साथ एकल आबंध द्वारा जुड़ा होता है।
108.example: The entire side chain is oxidised to the carboxyl group.

108.english_meaning: In chemistry, a carbon atom bonded to three other carbon atoms.
108.hindi_meaning: रसायन विज्ञान में, एक कार्बन परमाणु जो अन्य तीन कार्बन परमाणुओं से जुड़ा होता है (तृतीयक)।
108.example: Primary and secondary alkyl groups are oxidised, while the tertiary group is not affected.

108.english_meaning: Unsaturated hydrocarbons containing at least one carbon-carbon double bond.
108.hindi_meaning: असंतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन जिनमें कम से कम एक कार्बन-कार्बन द्वि-आबंध होता है।
108.example: Suitably substituted alkenes are also oxidised to carboxylic acids.

108.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing a -C≡N functional group.
108.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें -C≡N कार्यात्मक समूह होता है (सायनाइड)।
108.example: Nitriles are hydrolysed to amides and then to acids.

108.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing the carbonyl-nitrogen group (-C(=O)-N<).
108.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें कार्बोनिल-नाइट्रोजन समूह होता है।
108.example: Mild reaction conditions are used to stop the reaction at the amide stage.

108.english_meaning: Having undergone a chemical process in which a molecule is cleaved into two parts by the addition of water.
108.hindi_meaning: जल अपघटित होना (जल की उपस्थिति में यौगिक का टूटना)।
108.example: Nitriles are hydrolysed to amides in the presence of an acid or base catalyst.

108.english_meaning: Organometallic chemical compounds with the general formula RMgX, highly reactive in organic synthesis.
108.hindi_meaning: ऑर्गेनोमेटालिक रासायनिक यौगिक जिनका सामान्य सूत्र RMgX है, जो कार्बनिक संश्लेषण में अत्यधिक प्रतिक्रियाशील होते हैं।
108.example: Grignard reagents react with carbon dioxide to form salts of carboxylic acids.

108.english_meaning: The act or process of acidifying or becoming acidic.
108.example: Carboxylic acids are obtained after acidification with mineral acid.

109.english_meaning: Organic compounds containing a functional group with a carbon-hydrogen bond and a double-bonded oxygen.
109.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक यौगिक जिनमें एक ऐल्डेहाइड समूह होता है।
109.example: Aldehydes can be easily oxidized to carboxylic acids.

109.english_meaning: Organic compounds characterized by a carbonyl group bonded to two carbon atoms.
109.example: Acetone is one of the simplest ketones.

109.english_meaning: Organic acids containing a carboxyl functional group.
109.hindi_meaning: कार्बनिक अम्ल जिनमें कार्बोक्सिल समूह होता है।
109.example: Acetic acid is a common carboxylic acid found in vinegar.

109.english_meaning: Compounds in which one or more hydrogen atoms in an alkane are replaced by halogen atoms.
109.hindi_meaning: वे यौगिक जिनमें ऐल्केन का हाइड्रोजन परमाणु हैलोजन द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित होता है।
109.example: Alkyl halides are widely used as starting materials in organic synthesis.

109.english_meaning: Broken down or undergone a chemical reaction with water.
109.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटित (पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा टूटना)
109.example: Esters are hydrolysed to give carboxylic acids and alcohols.

109.english_meaning: Made with, containing, or dissolved in water.
109.example: Sodium hydroxide was added in aqueous solution.

109.english_meaning: A salt or ester of a carboxylic acid containing the carboxylate ion.

116.example: Esters of benzoic acid are widely used in perfumery.

116.english_meaning: The process of plating one metal upon another by hydrolysis using electric currents.
116.example: Methanoic acid is used in rubber, textile, dyeing, leather, and electroplating industries.

117.english_meaning: A reaction in which two molecules of an aldehyde or ketone with an alpha-hydrogen react in the presence of a base to form a beta-hydroxy aldehyde or ketone.
117.hindi_meaning: एल्डोल संघनन - वह अभिक्रिया जिसमें अल्फा-हाइड्रोजन युक्त एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन क्षार की उपस्थिति में संनमित होकर बीटा-हाइड्रॉक्सी यौगिक बनाते हैं।
117.example: Aldol condensation is a crucial carbon-carbon bond forming reaction in organic chemistry.

117.english_meaning: A chemical reaction that involves the base-induced disproportionation of an aldehyde lacking an alpha-hydrogen into a carboxylic acid and an alcohol.
117.hindi_meaning: कैनिज़ारो अभिक्रिया - बिना अल्फा-हाइड्रोजन वाले एल्डिहाइड की क्षार की उपस्थिति में होने वाली असमानुपातन अभिक्रिया जिसमें अल्कोहल और कार्बोक्सिलिक अम्ल बनते हैं।
117.example: Benzaldehyde undergoes Cannizzaro reaction in the presence of concentrated alkali.

117.english_meaning: A chemical reaction between molecular hydrogen and another compound or element, usually in the presence of a catalyst such as nickel, palladium, or platinum.
117.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरकी हाइड्रोजनीकरण - उत्प्रेरक की उपस्थिति में हाइड्रोजन का किसी यौगिक के साथ जुड़ने की प्रक्रिया।
117.example: Aldehydes can be reduced to alcohols by catalytic hydrogenation.

117.english_meaning: A chemical reaction used to reduce aldehydes or ketones to alkanes using zinc amalgam and concentrated hydrochloric acid.
117.hindi_meaning: क्लीमेंसन अपचयन - जिंक अमलगम और सांद्र हाइड्रोक्लोरिक अम्ल का उपयोग करके एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन को एल्केन में अपचयित करने की विधि।
117.example: The carbonyl group is converted to a methylene group via Clemmensen reduction.

117.english_meaning: A method used to convert carbonyl functionalities into methylene groups through the formation of an intermediate hydrazone.
117.hindi_meaning: वोल्फ-किश्नर अपचयन - हाइड्रोज़ोन मध्यवर्ती के माध्यम से कार्बोनिल समूह को मेथिलीन समूह में बदलने की रासायनिक विधि।
117.example: Wolff-Kishner reduction is performed in strongly basic conditions.

117.english_meaning: An alkaline solution of silver nitrate used to test for aldehydes, producing a characteristic silver mirror on the inner surface of the reaction vessel.
117.hindi_meaning: टोलेंस अभिकर्मक - सिल्वर नाइट्रेट का क्षारीय घोल जिसका उपयोग एल्डिहाइड की पहचान के लिए किया जाता है (सिल्वर मिरर परीक्षण)।
117.example: Aldehydes are easily oxidised by Tollens' reagent to form carboxylic acids.

117.english_meaning: A chemical solution used to differentiate between water-soluble aldehyde and ketone functional groups.
117.hindi_meaning: फेलिंग अभिकर्मक - कॉपर सल्फेट और रोशेल लवण का घोल जिसका उपयोग एल्डिहाइड और कीटोन में विभेद करने के लिए किया जाता है।
117.example: Aliphatic aldehydes reduce Fehling's reagent to a red precipitate of cuprous oxide.

117.english_meaning: An organometallic chemical reagent with the general formula RMgX, highly reactive and used for synthesizing various organic compounds.
117.hindi_meaning: ग्रिग्नार्ड अभिकर्मक - कार्बन-धातु यौगिक (RMgX) जिसका उपयोग नए कार्बन-कार्बन आबंध बनाने के लिए किया जाता है।
117.example: Carboxylic acids can be prepared by treatment of Grignard reagents with carbon dioxide.

117.english_meaning: A functional group consisting of a carbon atom bonded to both a hydroxyl group and a cyanide group.
117.hindi_meaning: सायनाहाइड्रिन - एक कार्बनिक यौगिक जिसमें एक ही कार्बन पर हाइड्रॉक्सी (-OH) और साइनाइड (-CN) समूह जुड़े होते हैं।
117.example: Addition of hydrogen cyanide to carbonyl compounds yields cyanohydrins.

117.english_meaning: A derivative formed by the condensation reaction of a ketone or aldehyde with semicarbazide.
117.hindi_meaning: सेमिकार्बेजोन - एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन की सेमिकार्बेजाइड के साथ संघनन अभिक्रिया से बना व्युत्पन्न यौगिक।
117.example: Semicarbazones are often crystalline solids used for characterization of carbonyl compounds.

117.english_meaning: A compound formed by the addition of an alcohol to an aldehyde, containing both an ether-like alkoxy group and an alcohol-like hydroxyl group on the same carbon.
117.hindi_meaning: हेमीएसिटाल - वह यौगिक जो एल्डिहाइड में अल्कोहल के जुड़ने से बनता है, जिसमें एक ही कार्बन पर -OH और -OR समूह होते हैं।
117.example: The methyl hemiacetal of formaldehyde is an intermediate in organic reactions.

117.english_meaning: A class of organic compounds belonging to imines, with the general formula R1R2C=N-OH.
117.hindi_meaning: ऑक्सिम - कार्बोनिल यौगिकों और हाइड्रॉक्सिलएमीन की अभिक्रिया से बना यौगिक जिसमें C=N-OH समूह होता है।
117.example: Cyclopropanone oxime can be drawn based on standard structural rules.

117.english_meaning: A system of names or terms used in a particular field of arts or sciences, such as the IUPAC system in chemistry.
117.hindi_meaning: नामकरण पद्धति - विज्ञान या किसी अन्य क्षेत्र में नियमों के अनुसार नाम रखने की प्रणाली।
117.example: Students must name the following compounds according to the IUPAC system of nomenclature.

117.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
117.hindi_meaning: जलअपघटन - जल के अणुओं द्वारा किसी यौगिक के बंधों को तोड़ने की रासायनिक प्रक्रिया।
117.example: Carboxylic acids are prepared by the hydrolysis of nitriles.

117.english_meaning: A compound that is derived from another compound by a chemical reaction.
117.hindi_meaning: व्युत्पन्न - वह यौगिक जो किसी अन्य मूल यौगिक से रासायनिक प्रक्रिया द्वारा प्राप्त किया जाता है।
117.example: Draw structures of the following 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazone derivatives.

118.english_meaning: Substances or mixtures used in chemical reactions to detect, measure, or produce other substances.
118.example: Tollens' reagent is used to distinguish between aldehydes and ketones.

118.english_meaning: An alloy of mercury with another metal, often used as a reducing agent in organic synthesis.
118.example: Zinc amalgam is used along with hydrochloric acid in the Clemmensen reduction.

118.english_meaning: A reaction in which an enol or an enolate ion reacts with a carbonyl compound to form a $\beta$-hydroxy aldehyde or $\beta$-hydroxy ketone.
118.example: Compounds containing alpha-hydrogen atoms undergo aldol condensation in the presence of a base.

118.english_meaning: A chemical reaction that involves the base-induced disproportionation of an aldehyde lacking an alpha-hydrogen atom into a primary alcohol and a carboxylic acid.
118.example: Formaldehyde undergoes the Cannizzaro reaction when treated with concentrated alkali.

118.english_meaning: A chemical species that donates an electron pair to an electrophile to form a chemical bond.
118.example: The cyanide ion acts as a strong nucleophile in addition reactions with carbonyl groups.

118.english_meaning: A chemical species that accepts an electron pair from a nucleophile to form a chemical bond.
118.example: Protons act as electrophiles during acid-catalyzed reactions.

118.english_meaning: Having undergone a chemical breakdown due to reaction with water.
118.example: The ester was hydrolysed with dilute sulphuric acid to yield an alcohol and a carboxylic acid.

118.english_meaning: A chemical reaction involving the loss of a water molecule from a reacting molecule.
118.example: The acid-catalyzed dehydration of alcohols produces alkenes.

118.english_meaning: The loss of electrons or an increase in the oxidation state of an atom, ion, or certain atoms in a molecule, often involving the gain of oxygen.
118.example: Vigorous oxidation of the organic compound yields 1,2-benzenedicarboxylic acid.

118.english_meaning: A compound that is derived from another compound by a chemical reaction.
118.example: The compound forms a colored 2,4-DNP derivative.

118.english_meaning: Formulas that show the arrangement of atoms in the molecule of a compound.
118.example: Draw the structural formulas for all possible isomers of the given molecular formula.

118.english_meaning: The process of introducing an acetyl group into a molecule.
118.example: Acetylation of primary amines produces secondary amides.

118.english_meaning: A chemical reaction that removes a carboxyl group and releases carbon dioxide (CO2).
118.example: Sodium salts of carboxylic acids undergo decarboxylation when heated with soda lime.

118.english_meaning: A reagent that does not contain carbon-hydrogen bonds, used to drive chemical transformations.
118.example: You may use any inorganic reagent required to achieve this synthesis.

118.english_meaning: The chemical transformation of one compound into another through specified reaction steps.
118.example: Practice these chemical conversions to understand reaction pathways better.

119.english_meaning: The production of chemical compounds by reaction from simpler materials.
119.hindi_meaning: संश्लेषण (सरल पदार्थों से रासायनिक यौगिकों का निर्माण)
119.example: Complete each synthesis by giving missing starting material, reagent or products.

119.english_meaning: A substance or compound added to a system to cause a chemical reaction, or test if one occurs.
119.example: Complete each synthesis by giving missing starting material, reagent or products.
Give plausible explanation for each of the following.

119.english_meaning: A cyclic ketone with a six-carbon ring.
119.example: Cyclohexanone forms cyanohydrin in good yield.

119.english_meaning: A functional group containing a cyano group and a hydroxyl group attached to the same carbon atom.
119.example: Cyclohexanone forms cyanohydrin in good yield.

119.english_meaning: A chemical compound used as a reagent for identifying aldehydes and ketones.
119.example: There are two –NH2 groups in semicarbazide.

119.english_meaning: A derivative of aldehydes or ketones formed by reaction with semicarbazide.
119.example: Only one –NH2 group is involved in the formation of semicarbazones.

119.english_meaning: A chemical compound derived from an acid (organic or inorganic) in which at least one –OH group is replaced by an –O–alkyl group.
119.example: During the preparation of esters from a carboxylic acid and an alcohol...

119.english_meaning: A substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself being consumed.
119.example: ...in the presence of an acid catalyst, water should be removed.

119.english_meaning: The mass of a given molecule, calculated as the sum of the atomic masses of all the atoms in the molecule.
119.example: The molecular mass of the compound is 86.

119.english_meaning: The loss of electrons or an increase in oxidation state by a molecule, atom, or ion.
119.example: On vigorous oxidation it gives ethanoic and propanoic acid.

119.english_meaning: One of two or more Lewis structures for a single molecule that cannot be represented accurately by a single Lewis structure.
119.example: Although phenoxide ion has more number of resonating structures than carboxylate ion...

119.english_meaning: An anion formed by the removal of a proton from the hydroxyl group of phenol.
119.example: Although phenoxide ion has more number of resonating structures...

119.english_meaning: The conjugate base of a carboxylic acid, containing the COO- group.
119.example: ...than carboxylate ion, carboxylic acid is a stronger acid than phenol.

119.english_meaning: An organic compound containing a carboxyl group (–COOH).
119.example: Carboxylic acid is a stronger acid than phenol.

120.english_meaning: A colorless liquid ketone used as a common industrial solvent.
120.hindi_meaning: एक रंगहीन तरल कीटोन जिसका उपयोग औद्योगिक विलायक के रूप में किया जाता है।
120.example: Butanone is frequently used in the production of plastics and textiles.

120.english_meaning: The simplest ketone, commonly known as acetone.
120.hindi_meaning: सबसे सरल कीटोन, जिसे आमतौर पर एसीटोन के रूप में जाना जाता है।
120.example: Propanone is highly miscible with water and many organic solvents.

120.english_meaning: An aldehyde with a three-carbon chain.
120.hindi_meaning: तीन कार्बन श्रृंखला वाला एक एल्डिहाइड।
120.example: Propanal is an intermediate in the synthesis of various chemical compounds.

120.english_meaning: A volatile liquid aldehyde, also known as acetaldehyde.
120.hindi_meaning: एक वाष्पशील तरल एल्डिहाइड, जिसे एसीटैल्डिहाइड भी कहा जाता है।
120.example: Ethanal is a key precursor in the manufacture of acetic acid.

120.english_meaning: The simplest aromatic ketone, consisting of a phenyl group attached to an acetyl group.
120.hindi_meaning: सबसे सरल सुगंधित (aromatic) कीटोन, जिसमें एक एसिटाइल समूह से जुड़ा फेनिल समूह होता है।
120.example: Acetophenone is used as a fragrance ingredient in soaps and perfumes.

120.english_meaning: An organic compound consisting of a benzene ring with a formyl substituent.
120.hindi_meaning: एक कार्बनिक यौगिक जिसमें फॉर्मिल प्रतिस्थापी के साथ बेंजीन वलय होता है।
120.example: Benzaldehyde has a characteristic almond-like odor.

120.english_meaning: A derivative of benzaldehyde containing a nitro group on the benzene ring.
120.hindi_meaning: बेंज़ल्डिहाइड का एक व्युत्पन्न जिसमें बेंजीन वलय पर एक नाइट्रो समूह होता है।
120.example: p-Nitrobenzaldehyde is often used in organic synthesis reactions.

120.english_meaning: Relating to a carboxylic acid containing a phenyl group attached to a propanoic acid chain.
120.hindi_meaning: एक कार्बोक्जिलिक एसिड से संबंधित जिसमें प्रोपेनोइक एसिड श्रृंखला से जुड़ा एक फेनिल समूह होता है।
120.example: 3-Phenylpropanoic acid is commonly known as hydrocinnamic acid.

120.english_meaning: Describing a carboxylic acid with a methyl group and a double bond in a four-carbon chain.
120.hindi_meaning: चार-कार्बन श्रृंखला में एक मिथाइल समूह और एक द्वि-आबंध वाले कार्बोक्जिलिक एसिड का वर्णन।
120.example: 3-Methylbut-2-enoic acid is an unsaturated carboxylic acid.

120.english_meaning: Referring to a carboxylic acid attached to a five-membered carbon ring.
120.hindi_meaning: पांच-सदस्यीय कार्बन वलय से जुड़े कार्बोक्जिलिक एसिड के संदर्भ में।
120.example: 2-Methylcyclopentanecarboxylic acid is a cyclic organic compound.

120.english_meaning: Relating to benzoic acid substituted with three nitro groups.
120.hindi_meaning: तीन नाइट्रो समूहों के साथ प्रतिस्थापित बेंज़ोइक एसिड से संबंधित।
120.example: 2,4,6-Trinitrobenzoic acid is a highly substituted aromatic acid.

120.english_meaning: A substance that dissolves a solute, resulting in a solution.
120.hindi_meaning: वह पदार्थ जो विलेय को घोलता है, जिससे एक घोल बनता है।
120.example: Water is often referred to as the universal solvent.

120.english_meaning: A substance formed from two or more elements chemically united in fixed proportions.
120.hindi_meaning: दो या दो से अधिक तत्वों के निश्चित अनुपात में रासायनिक रूप से जुड़ने से बना पदार्थ।
120.example: Water is a chemical compound consisting of hydrogen and oxygen.

120.english_meaning: A compound that is derived from a similar compound by a chemical reaction.
120.hindi_meaning: एक यौगिक जो रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा किसी समान यौगिक से प्राप्त होता है।
120.example: Many modern medicines are derivatives of natural plant extracts.

120.english_meaning: An atom or group of atoms that replaces one or more hydrogen atoms in a molecule.
120.hindi_meaning: एक परमाणु या परमाणुओं का समूह जो अणु में एक या अधिक हाइड्रोजन परमाणुओं को प्रतिस्थापित करता है।
120.example: The nitro group acts as a substituent on the benzene ring.

121.english_meaning: A class of organic compounds derived from ammonia by replacing hydrogen atoms with alkyl or aryl groups.
121.hindi_meaning: अमीन (कार्बनिक यौगिकों का एक वर्ग जो अमोनिया से उत्पन्न होता है)
121.example: Amines occur naturally in proteins, vitamins, and hormones.

121.english_meaning: Naturally occurring organic compounds containing nitrogen, often having pharmacological effects.
121.example: Alkaloids are found abundantly in many medicinal plants.

121.english_meaning: A substance that induces insensitivity to pain.
121.example: Novocain is used as an anaesthetic in dentistry.

121.english_meaning: A drug used to treat symptoms of allergies and cold by blocking histamine receptors.
121.example: Benadryl is a well-known antihistaminic drug.

121.english_meaning: Relating to compounds where four groups are attached to a central atom, such as nitrogen.
121.example: Quaternary ammonium salts are widely used as surfactants.

121.english_meaning: Compounds that lower the surface tension between two liquids or between a liquid and a solid.
121.example: Detergents and surfactants help in removing grease and oil.

121.english_meaning: Substances formed during a middle step of a chemical reaction between reactants and the desired product.
121.example: Diazonium salts serve as important intermediates in organic synthesis.

121.english_meaning: A class of organic compounds containing the characteristic group -N2+X-.
121.example: Diazonium salts are used in the preparation of various azo dyes.

121.english_meaning: Relating to or characterized by the presence of a benzene ring or related cyclic structure in organic chemistry.
121.example: Benzene is the simplest aromatic hydrocarbon.

121.english_meaning: Compounds that are derived from another compound by a chemical reaction.
121.hindi_meaning: व्युत्पन्न (किसी अन्य यौगिक से प्राप्त यौगिक)
121.example: Amines are considered as derivatives of ammonia.

121.english_meaning: Having undergone the process of combining atomic orbitals to form new hybrid orbitals.
121.example: Nitrogen orbitals in amines are sp3 hybridised.

121.english_meaning: Having the shape of a pyramid.
121.example: The molecular geometry of amines is pyramidal.

121.english_meaning: The production of chemical compounds by reaction from simpler materials.
121.example: Amines are widely used in the synthesis of medicines.

121.english_meaning: A hormone secreted by the adrenal glands that increases rates of blood circulation and breathing.
121.hindi_meaning: एड्रेनालाईन (एक हार्मोन जो रक्तचाप और ऊर्जा बढ़ाता है)
121.example: Adrenaline is a biologically active compound containing a secondary amino group.

122.english_meaning: A tertiary amine with the formula N(CH3)3, characterized by a pyramidal molecular structure.
122.hindi_meaning: एक तृतीयक एमीन जिसका रासायनिक सूत्र N(CH3)3 है, जिसकी संरचना पिरामिडीय होती है।
122.example: The bond angle in trimethylamine is slightly less than 109.5 degrees.

122.english_meaning: A univalent radical derived from an alkane by removing one hydrogen atom.
122.hindi_meaning: एल्केन से एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु हटाने पर प्राप्त होने वाला एक संयोजी मूलक।
122.example: An alkyl group is attached to the nitrogen atom in the amine.

122.english_meaning: A functional group derived from an aromatic ring by removing one hydrogen atom.
122.hindi_meaning: एक एरोमैटिक वलय से एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु हटाने पर प्राप्त होने वाला कार्यात्मक समूह।
122.example: The compound contains an aryl group bonded to the amine nitrogen.

122.english_meaning: In chemistry, an amine where one hydrogen of ammonia is replaced by an organic group.
122.hindi_meaning: रसायन विज्ञान में, वह एमीन जिसमें अमोनिया का एक हाइड्रोजन परमाणु कार्बनिक समूह द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित होता है।
122.example: Methylamine is a simple primary amine.

122.english_meaning: An amine where two hydrogen atoms of ammonia are replaced by organic groups.
122.hindi_meaning: वह एमीन जिसमें अमोनिया के दो हाइड्रोजन परमाणु कार्बनिक समूहों द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित होते हैं।
122.example: Dimethylamine is an example of a secondary amine.

122.english_meaning: An amine where all three hydrogen atoms of ammonia are replaced by organic groups.
122.hindi_meaning: वह एमीन जिसमें अमोनिया के तीनों हाइड्रोजन परमाणु कार्बनिक समूहों द्वारा प्रतिस्थापित होते हैं।
122.example: Trimethylamine is classified as a tertiary amine.

122.english_meaning: Relating to organic compounds in which carbon atoms form open chains.
122.hindi_meaning: उन कार्बनिक यौगिकों से संबंधित जिनमें कार्बन परमाणु खुली श्रृंखलाओं में व्यवस्थित होते हैं।
122.example: Aliphatic amines are named by prefixing the alkyl group to the word amine.

122.english_meaning: A system of names or terms used in a particular science or discipline.
122.hindi_meaning: किसी विशेष विज्ञान या अनुशासन में प्रयुक्त नामों या शब्दों की एक प्रणाली।
