149.english_meaning: Organic molecules that are produced by a living organism and are essential to biological processes.
149.hindi_meaning: जैव-अणु (जीवों में पाए जाने वाले जटिल कार्बनिक अणु)
149.example: Proteins, carbohydrates, and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules for life.

149.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
149.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटन (पानी के साथ अभिक्रिया द्वारा किसी यौगिक का टूटना)
149.example: The hydrolysis of sucrose yields glucose and fructose.

149.english_meaning: Sugars whose molecules contain two monosaccharide residues.
149.hindi_meaning: द्विशर्करा (दो मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों से बनी शर्करा)
149.example: Sucrose and maltose are common examples of disaccharides.

149.english_meaning: The simplest form of sugar that cannot be hydrolyzed into smaller carbohydrate molecules.
149.hindi_meaning: एकल शर्करा (कार्बोहाइड्रेट की सबसे सरल इकाई)
149.example: Glucose is the most abundant monosaccharide in nature.

149.english_meaning: Relating to a type of covalent bond that joins a carbohydrate molecule to another group.
149.hindi_meaning: ग्लाइकोसिडिक (शर्करा इकाइयों को जोड़ने वाला आबंध)
149.example: The two sugar units are connected by a glycosidic linkage.

149.english_meaning: Containing equal molar amounts of two or more substances.
149.example: The reaction produces an equimolar mixture of glucose and fructose.

149.english_meaning: Rotating the plane of polarized light to the right.
149.hindi_meaning: दक्षिण-ध्रुवण घूर्णक (प्रकाश को दाईं ओर मोड़ने वाला)

149.english_meaning: Rotating the plane of polarized light to the left.
149.hindi_meaning: वाम-ध्रुवण घूर्णक (प्रकाश को बाईं ओर मोड़ने वाला)

149.english_meaning: To turn upside down or reverse the position or direction of something.
149.example: The hydrolysis of sucrose results in the formation of invert sugar.

149.english_meaning: Relating to or containing an aldehyde group.
149.example: The aldehydic group is responsible for the reducing properties of glucose.

149.english_meaning: Relating to or containing a ketone group.
149.example: Fructose contains a ketonic functional group.

149.english_meaning: Relating to a group of atoms responsible for the characteristic chemical reactions of a compound.
149.example: The hydroxyl group is a common functional group in sugars.

149.english_meaning: A connection or bond between two things.
149.example: The oxygen atom acts as a bridge in the glycosidic linkage.

149.english_meaning: Capable of acting as a reducing agent in a chemical reaction.
149.hindi_meaning: अपचायक (जो अन्य पदार्थों का अपचयन कर सके)
149.example: Maltose is classified as a reducing sugar.

149.english_meaning: A liquid mixture in which the minor component is uniformly distributed within the major component.
149.hindi_meaning: विलयन (दो या अधिक पदार्थों का समांगी मिश्रण)
149.example: The sugar dissolves completely to form a clear solution.

150.english_meaning: A sugar (carbohydrate) composed of two monosaccharide units joined together.
150.hindi_meaning: दो मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों से बनी शर्करा।
150.example: Lactose is a common disaccharide found in milk.

150.english_meaning: The simplest form of sugar that cannot be hydrolyzed into smaller carbohydrate units.
150.hindi_meaning: शर्करा की सबसे सरल इकाई जिसे और अधिक नहीं तोड़ा जा सकता।
150.example: Glucose is a primary monosaccharide used by cells for energy.

150.english_meaning: Relating to the type of chemical bond that joins a carbohydrate molecule to another group.
150.hindi_meaning: कार्बोहाइड्रेट अणुओं को जोड़ने वाले रासायनिक बंध से संबंधित।
150.example: The glucose units are held together by a glycosidic linkage.

150.english_meaning: Complex carbohydrates made up of long chains of monosaccharide units.
150.hindi_meaning: मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों की लंबी श्रृंखला से बने जटिल कार्बोहाइड्रेट।
150.example: Starch and cellulose are common examples of polysaccharides.

150.english_meaning: A sugar that acts as a reducing agent due to the presence of a free aldehyde or ketone group.
150.hindi_meaning: वह शर्करा जो मुक्त एल्डिहाइड या कीटोन समूह के कारण अपचायक के रूप में कार्य करती है।
150.example: Because of its free aldehyde group, lactose is classified as a reducing sugar.

150.english_meaning: A substance consisting of very large molecules composed of many repeating subunits.
150.hindi_meaning: अनेक छोटी इकाइयों के जुड़ने से बनी एक विशाल अणु संरचना।
150.example: Starch is a natural polymer of glucose.

150.english_meaning: A water-soluble component of starch consisting of a long unbranched chain of glucose units.
150.hindi_meaning: स्टार्च का जल में घुलनशील घटक जो ग्लूकोज की सीधी श्रृंखला से बना होता है।

150.english_meaning: A water-insoluble component of starch consisting of a branched chain of glucose units.
150.hindi_meaning: स्टार्च का जल में अघुलनशील घटक जो ग्लूकोज की शाखित श्रृंखला से बना होता है।
150.example: Amylopectin makes up the majority of starch content.

150.english_meaning: Thickened underground parts of a stem or root that store nutrients.
150.hindi_meaning: पौधों के भूमिगत फूले हुए भाग (जैसे आलू) जिनमें पोषक तत्व जमा होते हैं।
150.example: Potatoes are common tubers rich in starch.

150.english_meaning: To be the parts or elements of something; to form or make up.
150.hindi_meaning: किसी चीज का निर्माण करना या उसका हिस्सा होना।
150.example: Water constitutes the majority of the human body.

150.english_meaning: Unable to be dissolved in a solvent, especially water.
150.hindi_meaning: जो किसी विलायक (विशेषकर पानी) में घुल न सके।

150.english_meaning: Relating to the food and drink that a person or animal habitually consumes.
150.example: Starch is a major dietary source of energy for humans.

150.english_meaning: The process of forming branches or offshoots from a main chain or structure.
150.hindi_meaning: मुख्य श्रृंखला से शाखाएं निकलने की प्रक्रिया।
150.example: The branching in amylopectin occurs via C1-C6 linkages.

150.english_meaning: Grasses cultivated for their edible grains, such as wheat, rice, or corn.
150.example: Cereals are a primary source of starch in our daily diet.

150.english_meaning: Relating to the physical construction or arrangement of parts.
150.example: Polysaccharides often serve as structural materials in plants.

151.english_meaning: Molecules that are produced by living organisms, essential for various biological processes.
151.hindi_meaning: जैव अणु (जीवित जीवों में पाए जाने वाले आवश्यक अणु)
151.example: Proteins, carbohydrates, and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules.

151.english_meaning: An insoluble substance that is the main constituent of plant cell walls and of vegetable fibers such as cotton.
151.hindi_meaning: सेलुलोज (पौधों की कोशिका भित्ति का मुख्य घटक)
151.example: Cellulose is the most abundant organic substance in the plant kingdom.

151.english_meaning: Existing or available in large quantities; overflowing.
151.example: Water is abundant on the Earth's surface.

151.english_meaning: Present as the strongest or main element; most noticeable or important.
151.hindi_meaning: प्रमुख, मुख्य रूप से पाया जाने वाला
151.example: Nitrogen is the predominant gas in the Earth's atmosphere.

151.english_meaning: A part of a whole, especially of a substance or mixture.
151.example: Hydrogen and oxygen are the main constituents of water.

151.english_meaning: A carbohydrate whose molecules consist of a number of sugar molecules bonded together.
151.example: Starch and cellulose are common examples of polysaccharides.

151.english_meaning: A type of covalent bond that joins a carbohydrate molecule to another group.
151.hindi_meaning: ग्लाइकोसाइडिक आबंध (शर्करा इकाइयों को जोड़ने वाला बंध)
151.example: Glucose units in cellulose are joined by a glycosidic linkage.

151.english_meaning: A substance deposited in bodily tissues as a store of carbohydrates, known as animal starch.
151.example: Excess glucose is stored in the liver and muscles as glycogen.

151.english_meaning: The non-water-soluble fraction of starch, consisting of branched chains of glucose units.
151.example: The structure of glycogen is very similar to amylopectin.

151.english_meaning: Biological molecules that act as catalysts and help complex reactions happen everywhere in life.
151.example: Digestive enzymes help break down food into simpler substances.

151.english_meaning: Relating to Ayurveda, the traditional Hindu system of medicine.
151.hindi_meaning: आयुर्वेदिक (प्राचीन भारतीय चिकित्सा प्रणाली से संबंधित)
151.example: Ayurvedic medicines often use natural herbs and honey.

151.english_meaning: Happening or coming immediately; very prompt.
151.example: Glucose provides an instant source of energy to the body.

151.english_meaning: The action or method of storing something for future use.
151.example: Carbohydrates act as food storage molecules in both plants and animals.

151.english_meaning: A large domain of prokaryotic microorganisms.
151.example: The cell wall of bacteria is made up of specialized substances.

151.english_meaning: Large movable equipment such as tables and chairs used to make a house suitable for living.
151.hindi_meaning: फर्नीचर, घर का सामान (मेज, कुर्सी आदि)
151.example: We build wooden furniture from cellulose found in plants.

152.english_meaning: A complex carbohydrate that forms the main part of the cell walls of plants and is used to make products like cotton and paper.
152.hindi_meaning: एक जटिल कार्बोहाइड्रेट जो पौधों की कोशिका भित्ति का मुख्य भाग बनाता है और कपास व कागज में पाया जाता है।
152.example: We clothe ourselves with cellulose in the form of cotton fibre.

152.english_meaning: A biological system comprising a network of entities connected to biological life.
152.hindi_meaning: जैविक प्रणाली जो जीवित तंत्रों से जुड़ी होती है।
152.example: Carbohydrates are found in biosystem in combination with many proteins and lipids.

152.english_meaning: Incapable of being dissolved in a liquid.
152.hindi_meaning: अघुलनशील, जो किसी द्रव में घुल न सके।
152.example: Cyclohexane or benzene are insoluble in water.

152.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
152.hindi_meaning: जल अपघटन, पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा किसी यौगिक का टूटना।
152.example: What are the expected products of hydrolysis of lactose?

152.english_meaning: Molecules that are produced by a living organism, such as proteins, carbohydrates, and nucleic acids.
152.hindi_meaning: जैविक अणु जो किसी जीवित जीव द्वारा निर्मित होते हैं, जैसे प्रोटीन और कार्बोहाइड्रेट।
152.example: Proteins are the most abundant biomolecules of the living system.

152.english_meaning: Existing or available in large quantities; plentiful.
152.example: Proteins are the most abundant biomolecules of the living system.

152.english_meaning: Substances made up of a large number of similar units bonded together.
152.hindi_meaning: बहुलक, जो समान इकाइयों की बड़ी संख्या से मिलकर बनते हैं।
152.example: All proteins are polymers of a-amino acids.

152.english_meaning: Relating to a specific group of atoms within a molecule that is responsible for the characteristic chemical reactions of those molecules.
152.hindi_meaning: कार्यात्मक, जो किसी यौगिक के विशेष रासायनिक गुण निर्धारित करता है।
152.example: Amino acids contain amino and carboxyl functional groups.

152.english_meaning: Arranged in classes or categories according to shared qualities or characteristics.
152.example: The amino acids can be classified as a, b, g, d and so on.

152.english_meaning: Of little value or importance, or in chemistry, a common non-systematic name for a substance.
152.hindi_meaning: सामान्य या प्रचलित नाम जो किसी वैज्ञानिक पद्धति पर आधारित न हो।
152.example: All a-amino acids have trivial names which usually reflect the property of that compound.

152.english_meaning: To show, express, or be a sign of something.
152.example: These names usually reflect the property of that compound or its source.

152.english_meaning: Typical of a particular person, place, or thing; a special feature.
152.example: Characteristic feature of side chain, R.

152.english_meaning: The simplest naturally occurring amino acid.
152.hindi_meaning: सबसे सरल प्राकृतिक रूप से पाया जाने वाला अमीनो एसिड।
152.example: Glycine is so named since it has a sweet taste.

152.english_meaning: A common amino acid that is used by cells to synthesize proteins.
152.hindi_meaning: एक प्रमुख अमीनो एसिड जिसका उपयोग कोशिकाएं प्रोटीन बनाने के लिए करती हैं।
152.example: Tyrosine was first obtained from cheese.

152.english_meaning: Symbolized or designated by a sign, letter, or formula.
152.example: Amino acids are generally represented by a three letter symbol.

153.english_meaning: Molecules that are produced by living organisms, including large macromolecules such as proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and nucleic acids.
153.hindi_meaning: जैविक अणु (जीवित जीवों में पाए जाने वाले अणु)
153.example: Proteins and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules required for life.

153.english_meaning: An essential amino acid that is important for protein synthesis and muscle metabolism.
153.example: Isoleucine is one of the essential amino acids needed by the human body.

153.english_meaning: An amino acid that is involved in various metabolic processes and the urea cycle.
153.example: Arginine plays a vital role in cell division and immune function.

153.english_meaning: An essential amino acid crucial for growth and muscle protein maintenance.
153.example: Lysine cannot be synthesized by the human body and must be obtained from food.

153.english_meaning: An acidic amino acid that acts as an important neurotransmitter in the brain.
153.example: Glutamic acid is classified as an acidic amino acid due to its extra carboxyl group.

153.english_meaning: An acidic amino acid used in the biosynthesis of proteins.
153.example: Aspartic acid contains two carboxyl groups, making it acidic in nature.

153.english_meaning: An amide derivative of glutamic acid, serving as an important source of energy for cells.
153.hindi_meaning: ग्लूटामिन (एक प्रकार का अमीनो अम्ल व्युत्पन्न)
153.example: Glutamine is the most abundant naturally occurring, non-essential amino acid in the body.

153.english_meaning: An amino acid that is important for the nervous system and metabolic processes.
153.example: Asparagine was the first amino acid to be discovered.

153.english_meaning: An essential amino acid that assists in the formation of collagen and elastin.
153.example: Threonine is an essential amino acid marked with an asterisk in nutritional tables.

153.english_meaning: A sulfur-containing amino acid that helps in protein structure and antioxidant defense.
153.example: Cysteine contains a thiol group which allows it to form disulfide bonds.

153.english_meaning: An essential sulfur-containing amino acid that acts as a starting point for protein synthesis.
153.example: Methionine is an essential amino acid obtained through diet.

153.english_meaning: An essential amino acid used by the body to produce melatonin and serotonin.
153.example: Tryptophan is crucial for regulating mood and sleep cycles.

153.english_meaning: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.
153.example: The classification of amino acids is based on the relative number of amino and carboxyl groups.

153.english_meaning: Produced by chemical synthesis, especially within a living organism.
153.example: Non-essential amino acids can be synthesised in the human body.

153.english_meaning: A chemical functional group consisting of a carbon atom doubly bonded to an oxygen atom and singly bonded to a hydroxyl group (-COOH).
153.example: The acidity of an amino acid depends on the number of carboxyl groups it possesses.

154.english_meaning: Having the structure and form of a crystal; composed of crystals.
154.example: Amino acids exist as colourless, crystalline solids at room temperature.

154.english_meaning: A molecule or ion having separate positively and negatively charged groups.
154.hindi_meaning: द्विध्रुवीय आयन (जिसमें धनात्मक और ऋणात्मक दोनों आवेश हों)
154.example: In aqueous solution, amino acids form a dipolar ion known as a zwitter ion.

154.english_meaning: Able to react both as an acid and as a base.
154.hindi_meaning: उभयधर्मी (जो अम्ल और क्षार दोनों के साथ अभिक्रिया करे)
154.example: Due to their structure, amino acids show amphoteric behaviour.

154.english_meaning: Lacking symmetry; having parts that fail to correspond to one another in shape or size.
154.example: The alpha-carbon atom in most amino acids is asymmetric, making them optically active.

154.english_meaning: Capable of rotating the plane of polarized light.
154.hindi_meaning: प्रकाशिक सक्रिय (जो ध्रुवित प्रकाश को घुमा सके)
154.example: Except glycine, all naturally occurring alpha-amino acids are optically active.

154.english_meaning: The spatial arrangement of atoms in a molecule.
154.example: Most naturally occurring amino acids have an L-configuration.

154.english_meaning: Substances that have a molecular structure consisting chiefly or entirely of a large number of similar units bonded together.
154.example: Proteins are complex polymers of alpha-amino acids.

154.english_meaning: A chemical bond formed between two molecules when the carboxyl group of one reacts with the amino group of the other.
154.hindi_meaning: पेप्टाइड बंध (अमीनो अम्लों के बीच का बंधन)
154.example: Amino acids are connected to each other by a peptide linkage.

154.english_meaning: The process of removing or getting rid of something.
154.example: The formation of a peptide bond results in the elimination of a water molecule.

154.english_meaning: A peptide composed of two amino-acid residues.
154.hindi_meaning: डाइपेप्टाइड (दो अमीनो अम्लों से बना अणु)
154.example: The product of the reaction between two amino acids is called a dipeptide.

154.english_meaning: A linear organic polymer consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded in a chain.
154.example: When the number of amino acids exceeds ten, the products are called polypeptides.

154.english_meaning: The parts of a molecule that remain after a reaction.
154.example: A protein is a polypeptide with more than hundred amino acid residues.

154.english_meaning: The specific three-dimensional shape of a protein molecule.
154.hindi_meaning: संरचना या विन्यास (प्रोटीन का त्रिविमीय आकार)
154.example: Insulin is considered a protein because it has a well-defined conformation.

154.english_meaning: Consisting of or characterized by fibers.
154.example: Fibrous proteins are generally insoluble in water.
Fibrous proteins like keratin are insoluble in water.

155.english_meaning: Molecules that are produced by living organisms, including large macromolecules such as proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and nucleic acids.
155.hindi_meaning: जैव अणु (वे अणु जो जीवित जीवों द्वारा उत्पादित होते हैं, जैसे प्रोटीन, कार्बोहाइड्रेट आदि)
155.example: Proteins and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules required for life.
Insulin is an example of a globular protein that dissolves easily in water.

155.english_meaning: A linear organic polymer consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded together in a chain.
155.hindi_meaning: पॉलीपेप्टाइड (अमीनो एसिड की लंबी श्रृंखला जो पेप्टाइड बॉन्ड से जुड़ी होती है)
155.example: Proteins are made up of one or more polypeptide chains.

155.english_meaning: Relating to the fourth stage or level in a structure, specifically the spatial arrangement of multiple polypeptide subunits in proteins.
155.hindi_meaning: चतुर्धातुक / चतुर्थक (प्रोटीन की संरचना का चौथा स्तर)
155.example: The quaternary structure of hemoglobin involves four polypeptide subunits.

155.english_meaning: The specific sequence of amino acids linked together in a polypeptide chain.
155.hindi_meaning: प्राथमिक संरचना (अमीनो एसिड का विशिष्ट क्रम)
155.example: Any mutation can alter the primary structure of a protein.

155.english_meaning: The general three-dimensional form of local segments of biopolymers such as proteins, formed by regular folding due to hydrogen bonding.
155.hindi_meaning: द्वितीयक संरचना (हाइड्रोजन आबंधन के कारण प्रोटीन श्रृंखला का मुड़ना)
155.example: Alpha-helix and beta-pleated sheet are common types of secondary structure.

155.english_meaning: The overall three-dimensional folding of a polypeptide chain.
155.hindi_meaning: तृतीयक संरचना (पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला की समग्र त्रि-आयामी वलन)
155.example: Tertiary structure gives rise to fibrous and globular molecular shapes.

155.english_meaning: A common secondary structure of proteins where the polypeptide chain twists into a right-handed screw shape held by hydrogen bonds.
155.example: The alpha-helix is stabilized by internal hydrogen bonds.

155.english_meaning: A secondary protein structure where peptide chains are stretched out and laid side by side, resembling pleated folds.
155.example: In a beta-pleated sheet structure, chains are held together by intermolecular hydrogen bonds.

155.english_meaning: A specific monomer unit that is part of a polymer chain, such as an amino acid in a polypeptide.
155.hindi_meaning: अवशेष / इकाई (बहुलक श्रृंखला में मौजूद एक इकाई)
155.example: Each amino acid residue is connected to the next via a peptide bond.

155.english_meaning: Covalent bonds derived from two thiol groups, important in stabilizing tertiary protein structures.
155.hindi_meaning: डिसल्फाइड बंधन (प्रोटीन की संरचना को स्थिर करने वाले रासायनिक आबंध)
155.example: Disulphide linkages help stabilize the folded structure of many proteins.

155.english_meaning: Relating to stationary electric charges or fields, responsible for attractive forces between charged groups in molecules.
155.hindi_meaning: स्थिरवैद्युत (आवेशित समूहों के बीच लगने वाला आकर्षण बल)
155.example: Electrostatic forces of attraction contribute to protein folding.

155.english_meaning: A smaller component or molecule that functions as part of a larger whole, especially in proteins.
155.hindi_meaning: उप-इकाई (एक बड़ी संरचना का छोटा हिस्सा)
155.example: Hemoglobin is made of four polypeptide sub-units.

155.hindi_meaning: स्थानिक / त्रिविमीय (स्थान या अंतरिक्ष से संबंधित)
155.example: The spatial arrangement of protein subunits determines its function.

155.hindi_meaning: अंतराअणुक (दो अणुओं के बीच होने वाला)
155.example: Intermolecular hydrogen bonds hold adjacent polypeptide chains together.

156.english_meaning: Represented by or presented in the form of a diagram or graph.
156.example: The textbook provides a clear diagrammatic representation of the cell structure.

156.english_meaning: The action of speaking or acting on behalf of someone or the exhibition of something.
156.example: A visual representation helps students understand complex scientific concepts easily.

156.english_meaning: Relating to or denoting the fourth stage or level in a hierarchical series.
156.example: Haemoglobin possesses a quaternary structure made up of four sub-units.

156.english_meaning: A simple organic compound containing both a carboxyl and an amino group, combining to form proteins.
156.example: Proteins are long chains of amino acids linked together.

156.english_meaning: A red protein responsible for transporting oxygen in the blood of vertebrates.
156.hindi_meaning: हीमोग्लोबिन (रक्त में ऑक्सीजन ले जाने वाला प्रोटीन)
156.example: Haemoglobin has a complex quaternary protein structure.

156.english_meaning: Relating to biology or living organisms.
156.example: Enzymes play a crucial role in various biological processes.

156.english_meaning: Having or appearing to have length, breadth, and depth.
156.example: Native proteins exist in a unique three-dimensional structure.

156.english_meaning: A protein in its functional, folded, and biologically active state found in living systems.
156.example: A native protein maintains its specific three-dimensional conformation and biological activity.

156.english_meaning: Caused or forced to undergo a particular experience or treatment.
156.example: When the solution is subjected to high heat, the chemical bonds break.

156.english_meaning: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object.
156.example: A sudden change in temperature can alter enzyme activity.

156.english_meaning: A weak chemical bond between an electronegative atom and a hydrogen atom bound to another atom.
156.example: Hydrogen bonds are easily disturbed during the denaturation of proteins.

156.english_meaning: Interrupted, upset, or altered from a normal state or position.
156.example: The delicate balance of the ecosystem was disturbed by industrial waste.

156.english_meaning: Small spherical bodies or drops of a substance.
156.example: During protein denaturation, the protein globules unfold.

156.english_meaning: Straightened out from a wound or spiral shape.
156.hindi_meaning: खुला हुआ कुंडल / बिना लिपटा हुआ
156.example: The helical structure of the protein became uncoiled upon heating.

156.english_meaning: A process in which folding structure of a protein is altered due to external stress, losing its function.
156.hindi_meaning: विकृतीकरण (प्रोटीन की संरचना का नष्ट होना)
156.example: Boiling an egg causes the denaturation of the albumin protein present in it.

157.english_meaning: The process of modifying the molecular structure of a protein, resulting in the loss of its biological activity.
157.hindi_meaning: प्रोटीन की संरचना में बदलाव की प्रक्रिया जिससे उसकी जैविक सक्रियता समाप्त हो जाती है।
157.example: The denaturation of proteins occurs when an egg is boiled.

157.english_meaning: The process of a liquid changing to a solid or semi-solid state, often by clotting.
157.hindi_meaning: द्रव का ठोस या अर्ध-ठोस अवस्था में जमना (स्कंदन)।
157.example: Coagulation of egg white happens when it is subjected to high heat.

157.english_meaning: Substances, typically enzymes, that increase the rate of chemical reactions in living organisms.
157.hindi_meaning: वे पदार्थ (मुख्यतः एंजाइम) जो जीवित जीवों में रासायनिक अभिक्रियाओं की गति को बढ़ाते हैं।
157.example: Enzymes act as essential biocatalysts in our digestive system.

157.english_meaning: Shaped like a globe or sphere; in proteins, it refers to a compact, folded structure.
157.hindi_meaning: गोलाकार; प्रोटीन के संदर्भ में एक सघन और मुड़ी हुई संरचना।
157.example: Most enzymes are globular proteins that are soluble in water.

157.english_meaning: A substance or surface on which an enzyme acts during a chemical reaction.
157.hindi_meaning: वह पदार्थ जिस पर एंजाइम अपनी रासायनिक क्रिया करता है।
157.example: Enzymes are highly specific to the substrate they work upon.

157.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
157.hindi_meaning: जल के साथ अभिक्रिया द्वारा किसी यौगिक का अपघटन।
157.example: Maltase catalyzes the hydrolysis of maltose into glucose.

157.english_meaning: An enzyme that catalyzes the transfer of electrons from one molecule to another.
157.hindi_meaning: वह एंजाइम जो एक अणु से दूसरे अणु में इलेक्ट्रॉनों के स्थानांतरण को उत्प्रेरित करता है।
157.example: Oxidoreductase enzymes are vital for cellular respiration.

157.english_meaning: The minimum amount of energy required to initiate a chemical reaction.
157.hindi_meaning: किसी रासायनिक अभिक्रिया को शुरू करने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम ऊर्जा।
157.example: Enzymes function by significantly reducing the activation energy of reactions.

157.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something, especially a nutrient required for health.
157.hindi_meaning: किसी आवश्यक तत्व (जैसे विटामिन) की कमी।
157.example: Vitamin deficiency can lead to specific health disorders.

157.english_meaning: Produced by a chemical or biological process, especially by living organisms.
157.hindi_meaning: किसी रासायनिक या जैविक प्रक्रिया द्वारा निर्मित होना।
157.example: Most vitamins cannot be synthesised by the human body.

157.english_meaning: The most favorable or best condition for a process to occur.
157.hindi_meaning: किसी प्रक्रिया के लिए सबसे अनुकूल या सर्वोत्तम स्थिति।
157.example: Vitamins are essential for the optimum growth of the body.

157.english_meaning: The ability of a substance to dissolve in a solvent, typically water.
157.hindi_meaning: किसी पदार्थ की विलायक (जैसे पानी) में घुलने की क्षमता।
157.example: The solubility of amino acids varies depending on their structure.

157.english_meaning: To cause or accelerate a chemical reaction by acting as a catalyst.
157.hindi_meaning: उत्प्रेरक के रूप में कार्य करके रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की गति बढ़ाना।
157.example: Enzymes catalyse reactions that would otherwise be too slow.

157.english_meaning: Relating to biology or living organisms.
157.hindi_meaning: जीव विज्ञान या जीवित जीवों से संबंधित।
157.example: Vitamins perform various biological functions in our body.

157.english_meaning: The organization of different elements to work together effectively.
157.hindi_meaning: विभिन्न तत्वों का एक साथ मिलकर प्रभावी ढंग से कार्य करना (समन्वय)।
157.example: Life depends on the coordination of complex chemical reactions.

158.english_meaning: Organic compounds needed in small amounts for normal growth and health of the body.
158.example: Vitamins are essential organic compounds required for maintaining good health.

158.english_meaning: Invented or created a new word or phrase.
158.example: The term 'Vitamine' was coined from the words vital and amine.

158.english_meaning: The ability of a substance to dissolve in a given solvent.
158.example: Vitamins are classified into two groups based on their solubility in water or fat.

158.english_meaning: Used for the storage of fat in the body.
158.example: Fat-soluble vitamins are stored in the liver and adipose tissues.

158.english_meaning: Eliminated or discharged waste matter from the body.
158.hindi_meaning: मल-मूत्र या अपशिष्ट के रूप में बाहर निकालना उत्सर्जित करना
158.example: Water-soluble vitamins are readily excreted in urine.

158.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something essential, such as a nutrient.
158.example: Vitamin C deficiency can lead to a disease known as scurvy.

158.english_meaning: A medical condition in which the eye fails to produce tears, leading to hardening of the cornea.
158.hindi_meaning: क्सिरोथैल्मिया (आंख के कॉर्निया का सख्त होना)
158.example: Xerophthalmia is caused by the deficiency of vitamin A.

158.english_meaning: A disorder of the lips characterized by scaling and fissures at the corners of the mouth.
158.hindi_meaning: काइलोसिस (होंठों और मुंह के कोनों का फटना)
158.example: Vitamin B2 deficiency can result in cheilosis and skin irritation.

158.english_meaning: Sudden, violent, irregular movements of a limb or of the body caused by involuntary contraction of muscles.
158.example: Severe vitamin deficiency can sometimes trigger convulsions.

158.english_meaning: Having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way (used here with anaemia).
158.example: Pernicious anaemia is caused by the lack of vitamin B12.

158.english_meaning: A condition in which there is a deficiency of red blood cells or of haemoglobin in the blood.
158.example: A balanced diet helps prevent nutritional anaemia.

158.english_meaning: A disease caused by a deficiency of vitamin C, characterized by swollen, bleeding gums.
158.example: Sailors in the past suffered from scurvy due to a lack of fresh fruits.

158.english_meaning: A disease of children caused by vitamin D deficiency, characterized by softening and distortion of the bones.
158.hindi_meaning: रिकेट्स (सूखा रोग / हड्डियों का कमजोर होना)
158.example: Sunlight exposure helps children prevent rickets.

158.english_meaning: Softening of the bones, typically through a deficiency of vitamin D or calcium in adults.
158.hindi_meaning: ऑस्टियोमलेशिया (वयस्कों में हड्डियों का नरम होना)
158.example: Osteomalacia causes bone deformities and joint pain in adults.

158.english_meaning: Physical distortions or malformations in the body's structure.
158.example: Severe nutritional deficiencies can lead to permanent bone deformities.

159.english_meaning: Organic molecules that are produced by a living organism and are essential to biological processes.
159.hindi_meaning: जैव-अणु (जीवों में पाए जाने वाले कार्बनिक अणु)
159.example: Proteins and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules for life.

159.english_meaning: The process by which characteristics are passed from parents to their offspring.
159.hindi_meaning: आनुवंशिकता (माता-पिता से संतानों में गुणों का संचार)
159.example: The study of heredity helps us understand why children resemble their parents.

159.english_meaning: Thread-like structures of nucleic acids and protein found in the nucleus of most living cells, carrying genetic information.
159.hindi_meaning: गुणसूत्र (कोशिका के केंद्रक में स्थित आनुवंशिक वाहक)
159.example: Humans typically have 46 chromosomes in each cell.

159.english_meaning: Substances that have a molecular structure consisting chiefly or entirely of a large number of similar units bonded together.
159.hindi_meaning: बहुलक (समान इकाइयों से बनी लंबी श्रृंखला)
159.example: Nucleic acids are long chain polymers of nucleotides.

159.english_meaning: The basic structural units of nucleic acids, consisting of a sugar, a phosphate group, and a nitrogenous base.
159.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियोटाइड (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल की मूल संरचनात्मक इकाई)
159.example: DNA is composed of a sequence of specific nucleotides.

159.english_meaning: The structure of DNA, consisting of two strands that wind around each other like a twisted ladder.
159.example: Watson and Crick discovered the double helix structure of DNA.

159.english_meaning: A colorless crystalline compound with basic properties, forming the base of DNA and RNA.
159.hindi_meaning: प्यूरीन (नाइट्रोजन युक्त क्षारक का एक प्रकार)
159.example: Adenine and guanine are the two main types of purine bases in DNA.

159.english_meaning: A heterocyclic aromatic organic compound similar to benzene, forming the base of DNA and RNA.
159.hindi_meaning: पिरिमिडीन (नाइट्रोजन युक्त क्षारक का एक प्रकार)
159.example: Cytosine and thymine are examples of pyrimidine bases.

159.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize the qualities of each other.
159.hindi_meaning: पूरक (एक-दूसरे के साथ मेल खाने वाला)
159.example: The complementary pairing of bases ensures accurate DNA replication.

159.english_meaning: Formed by the combination of genetic material from different sources.
159.hindi_meaning: पुनर्संयोजित (विभिन्न स्रोतों से प्राप्त आनुवंशिक सामग्री)
159.example: Recombinant DNA technology has revolutionized modern medicine.

159.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
159.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटन (पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा यौगिक का टूटना)
159.example: Complete hydrolysis of DNA yields pentose sugar and phosphoric acid.

159.english_meaning: Relating to a cyclic compound having atoms of at least two different elements as members of its ring(s).
159.hindi_meaning: विषमचक्रीय (वलय में दो या अधिक प्रकार के परमाणुओं वाला यौगिक)
159.example: Nitrogen-containing heterocyclic compounds are essential components of nucleic acids.

159.english_meaning: A specific part or functional group of a molecule.
159.hindi_meaning: अंश या भाग (अणु का एक विशिष्ट हिस्सा)
159.example: In DNA, the sugar moiety is deoxyribose.

159.english_meaning: The quality of being easily broken or damaged.
159.example: Vitamin E deficiency can lead to increased fragility of red blood cells.

159.english_meaning: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.
159.example: The nucleus is responsible for the transmission of inherent characters.

160.english_meaning: A nitrogenous base found in RNA (but not in DNA) that pairs with adenine.
160.hindi_meaning: एक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जो आरएनए (आर.एन.ए.) में पाया जाता है लेकिन डीएनए में नहीं।
160.example: RNA contains uracil as its fourth base instead of thymine.

160.english_meaning: A nitrogenous base found in DNA (but not typically in RNA) that pairs with adenine.
160.hindi_meaning: एक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जो डीएनए में पाया जाता है।
160.example: Thymine is one of the fundamental bases present in DNA.

160.english_meaning: A nitrogenous base found in both DNA and RNA that pairs with guanine.
160.hindi_meaning: एक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जो डीएनए और आरएनए दोनों में पाया जाता है।
160.example: Cytosine forms three hydrogen bonds with guanine in nucleic acids.

160.english_meaning: A purine base found in DNA and RNA that pairs with thymine in DNA and uracil in RNA.
160.hindi_meaning: डीएनए और आरएनए में पाया जाने वाला एक प्रमुख क्षारक।
160.example: Adenine always pairs with thymine in a DNA double helix.

160.english_meaning: A nitrogenous base found in both DNA and RNA that pairs with cytosine.
160.hindi_meaning: डीएनए और आरएनए में पाया जाने वाला एक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जो साइटोसिन के साथ जोड़ा बनाता है।
160.example: Guanine pairs exclusively with cytosine in nucleic acid structures.

160.english_meaning: A compound formed by the attachment of a nitrogenous base to a sugar molecule.
160.hindi_meaning: शर्करा अणु से किसी क्षारक के जुड़ने से बनी इकाई को न्यूक्लियोसाइड कहते हैं।
160.example: A nucleoside consists of a nitrogenous base linked to a sugar.

160.english_meaning: The basic structural unit of nucleic acids, consisting of a nucleoside linked to a phosphate group.
160.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लिक अम्ल की मूल इकाई जिसमें न्यूक्लियोसाइड फॉस्फोरस अम्ल से जुड़ा होता है।
160.example: Nucleotides join together to form long chains of DNA and RNA.

160.english_meaning: A mineral acid that links to the 5'-position of sugar in a nucleotide.
160.hindi_meaning: एक खनिज अम्ल जो न्यूक्लियोटाइड में शर्करा के 5'-स्थान पर जुड़ा होता है।
160.example: Phosphoric acid contributes the phosphate group in nucleic acids.

160.english_meaning: A specific segment or functional part of a molecule.
160.hindi_meaning: किसी अणु का एक विशिष्ट भाग या अंश।
160.example: The sugar moiety is linked to phosphoric acid at the 5'-position.

160.english_meaning: A type of chemical bond linking nucleotides together in DNA and RNA.
160.hindi_meaning: फॉस्फोडाईएस्टर बंध जो न्यूक्लियोटाइड को आपस में जोड़ता है।
160.example: Nucleotides are joined together by phosphodiester linkages.

160.english_meaning: A connection or bond between atoms or chemical groups.
160.example: The phosphodiester linkage holds the sugar-phosphate backbone together.

160.english_meaning: A simple sugar containing five carbon atoms, such as ribose or deoxyribose.
160.hindi_meaning: पाँच कार्बन परमाणुओं वाली शर्करा (जैसे राइबोस या डिऑक्सीराइबोस)।
160.example: DNA contains a pentose sugar called 2-deoxyribose.

160.english_meaning: A molecule consisting of two nucleotides joined by a phosphodiester bond.
160.hindi_meaning: दो न्यूक्लियोटाइड से मिलकर बना अणु।
160.example: The formation of a typical dinucleotide illustrates how nucleic chains grow.

160.english_meaning: To recognize or treat as different; to tell apart.
160.example: Prime marks (1', 2') are used to distinguish sugar carbons from base carbons.

160.english_meaning: The action of fastening or connecting one thing to another.
160.hindi_meaning: किसी चीज़ का जुड़ाव या संयोजन।
160.example: The attachment of a base to the sugar forms a nucleoside.

161.english_meaning: Molecules that are produced by living organisms, including large macromolecules such as proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and nucleic acids.
161.hindi_meaning: जैविक अणु (जीवित जीवों द्वारा निर्मित अणु जैसे प्रोटीन, कार्बोहाइड्रेट, वसा और न्यूक्लिक अम्ल)
161.example: Proteins and nucleic acids are essential biomolecules found in all living cells.

161.english_meaning: A complex organic substance present in living cells, especially DNA or RNA, whose molecules consist of many nucleotides linked in a long chain.
161.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लिक अम्ल (डीएनए या आरएनए जैसे जटिल कार्बनिक अणु जो आनुवंशिक जानकारी ले जाते हैं)
161.example: DNA is a type of nucleic acid that stores genetic information.

161.english_meaning: A molecule consisting of two nucleotides joined together by a phosphodiester bond.
161.hindi_meaning: डाइन्यूक्लियोटाइड (दो न्यूक्लियोटाइड से मिलकर बना अणु)
161.example: A dinucleotide is formed when two single nucleotides link together in a chain.

161.english_meaning: An object having a three-dimensional shape like that of a series of rings or a spiral.
161.example: DNA is famously known for its double helix structure.

161.english_meaning: The specific sequence of nucleotides in the chain of a nucleic acid.
161.hindi_meaning: प्राथमिक संरचना (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल की श्रृंखला में न्यूक्लियोटाइड का विशिष्ट क्रम)
161.example: The primary structure of a protein or nucleic acid determines its unique properties.

161.english_meaning: The general three-dimensional folding or coiling form of a polymer chain, such as the double strand helix in DNA.
161.hindi_meaning: द्वितीयक संरचना (पॉलिमर श्रृंखला का त्रिविमीय कुंडलित रूप)
161.example: James Watson and Francis Crick discovered the secondary structure of DNA.

161.english_meaning: A weak chemical bond between an electronegative atom and a hydrogen atom bound to another electronegative atom.
161.hindi_meaning: हाइड्रोजन आबंध (दो परमाणुओं के बीच का कमजोर रासायनिक बंधन)
161.example: The two strands of DNA are held together by hydrogen bonds.

161.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize each other's qualities, or in genetics, matching base pairs like adenine with thymine.
161.hindi_meaning: पूरक (एक-दूसरे के अनुकूल या मेल खाने वाले जैसे डीएनए में बेस जोड़े)
161.example: The two strands of DNA are complementary to each other.

161.english_meaning: A compound that is one of the four constituent bases of nucleic acids, pairing with thymine in DNA.
161.hindi_meaning: एडेनिन (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल का एक नाइट्रोजनयुक्त क्षारक जो डीएनए में थायमिन से जुड़ता है)
161.example: Adenine always pairs with thymine in a DNA molecule.

161.english_meaning: A compound that is one of the four constituent bases of nucleic acids, pairing with adenine in DNA.
161.hindi_meaning: थायमिन (डीएनए का एक मुख्य क्षारक जो एडेनिन के साथ जोड़ा बनाता है)
161.example: Thymine forms hydrogen bonds with adenine.

161.english_meaning: A compound that is one of the four constituent bases of nucleic acids, pairing with guanine.
161.hindi_meaning: साइटोसिन (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल का एक क्षारक जो गुआनिन के साथ जोड़ा बनाता है)
161.example: Cytosine pairs specifically with guanine in nucleic acids.

161.english_meaning: A compound that is one of the four constituent bases of nucleic acids, pairing with cytosine.
161.hindi_meaning: गुआनिन (न्यूक्लिक अम्ल का एक मुख्य क्षारक)
161.example: Guanine forms hydrogen bonds with cytosine in the DNA double helix.

161.english_meaning: The form of RNA in which genetic information transcribed from DNA as a sequence of bases is transferred to a ribosome.
161.hindi_meaning: संदेशवाहक आरएनए (m-RNA) (जो डीएनए से आनुवंशिक जानकारी ribosomes तक पहुँचाता है)
161.example: Messenger RNA (m-RNA) plays a crucial role in protein synthesis.

161.english_meaning: RNA that is a permanent structural component of ribosomes, essential for protein translation.
161.example: Ribosomal RNA (r-RNA) is found inside the ribosomes of cells.

161.english_meaning: RNA consisting of folded molecules that transport specific amino acids to the ribosome during protein synthesis.
161.hindi_meaning: स्थानांतरण आरएनए (t-RNA) (प्रोटीन संश्लेषण के दौरान अमीनो अम्ल को राइबोसोम तक ले जाने वाला अणु)
161.example: Transfer RNA (t-RNA) helps in decoding a messenger RNA sequence into a protein.

162.english_meaning: A technique used to identify individuals by characteristics of their DNA.
162.hindi_meaning: डी.एन.ए. फिंगरप्रिंटिंग (किसी व्यक्ति की विशिष्ट डी.एन.ए. संरचना द्वारा उसकी पहचान करने की तकनीक)
162.example: DNA fingerprinting is widely used in forensic laboratories for the identification of criminals.

162.english_meaning: Relating to or denoting the application of scientific methods and techniques to the investigation of crime.
162.example: Forensic laboratories analyze evidence collected from crime scenes.

162.english_meaning: The state of being someone's father.
162.hindi_meaning: पितृत्व (पिता होने की स्थिति या संबंध)
162.example: DNA testing can accurately determine the paternity of an individual.

162.english_meaning: The passing on of physical or mental characteristics genetically from one generation to another.
162.example: DNA serves as the chemical basis of heredity in living organisms.

162.english_meaning: The action or process of copying or duplicating something.
162.example: A DNA molecule is capable of self duplication during cell division.

162.english_meaning: Complex organic molecules such as DNA and RNA that present in living cells.
162.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लिक अम्ल (डी.एन.ए. और आर.एन.ए. जैसे जटिल जैविक अणु)
162.example: An important function of nucleic acids is protein synthesis in the cell.

162.english_meaning: The process by which cells make proteins based on genetic messages.
162.hindi_meaning: प्रोटीन संश्लेषण (कोशिकाओं द्वारा प्रोटीन का निर्माण)
162.example: Proteins are synthesized by various RNA molecules using the message present in DNA.

162.english_meaning: Regulatory substances produced in an organism and transported in tissue fluids to stimulate specific cells or tissues.
162.hindi_meaning: हार्मोन (अंतःस्रावी ग्रंथियों द्वारा स्रावित रासायनिक संदेशवाहक)
162.example: Hormones act as intercellular messengers in the body.

162.english_meaning: Glands of the endocrine system that secrete their products directly into the blood.
162.example: Hormones are produced by endocrine glands in the body.

162.english_meaning: A class of organic compounds with a particular molecular structure, including certain hormones.
162.hindi_meaning: स्टेरॉइड (एक प्रकार के रासायनिक यौगिक या हार्मोन)
162.example: Some hormones are chemical steroids, such as estrogens and androgens.

162.english_meaning: Linear organic polymers consisting of a large number of amino-acid residues bonded in a chain.
162.hindi_meaning: पॉलीपेप्टाइड (अमीनो अम्लों की श्रृंखला से बने अणु)
162.example: Insulin and endorphins are examples of hormones that are polypeptides.

162.english_meaning: A hormone produced in the pancreas that regulates the amount of glucose in the blood.
162.hindi_meaning: इंसुलिन (रक्त में शर्करा के स्तर को नियंत्रित करने वाला हार्मोन)
162.example: The role of insulin is to keep the blood glucose level within a narrow limit.

162.english_meaning: A hormone formed in the pancreas that promotes the breakdown of glycogen to glucose in the liver.
162.hindi_meaning: ग्लूकागॉन (रक्त में ग्लूकोज का स्तर बढ़ाने वाला हार्मोन)
162.example: The hormone glucagon tends to increase the glucose level in the blood.

162.english_meaning: Things that rouse activity or energy in someone or something; a plural of stimulus.
162.example: Epinephrine and norepinephrine mediate responses to external stimuli.

162.english_meaning: The main hormone produced by the thyroid gland, acting to increase metabolic rate.
162.hindi_meaning: थाइरॉक्सिन (थायराइड ग्रंथि द्वारा उत्पादित प्रमुख हार्मोन)
162.example: Thyroxine produced in the thyroid gland is an iodinated derivative of amino acid tyrosine.

164.english_meaning: Complex organic molecules such as DNA and RNA that store and transfer genetic information in living things.
164.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लिक अम्ल (जैविक अणु जो आनुवंशिक जानकारी संग्रहीत और स्थानांतरित करते हैं)
164.example: Nucleic acids are responsible for the transfer of characters from parents to offsprings.

164.english_meaning: The basic structural units of nucleic acids, consisting of a base, a pentose sugar, and a phosphate group.
164.example: Nucleic acids are the polymers of nucleotides which consist of a base, a pentose sugar and a phosphate moiety.

164.english_meaning: A specific part or functional group of a molecule.
164.hindi_meaning: अणु का एक भाग या घटक
164.example: Each nucleotide consists of a base, a pentose sugar and a phosphate moiety.

164.english_meaning: The passing on of physical or mental characteristics from parents to their offspring.
164.hindi_meaning: वंशानुगति (माता-पिता से बच्चों में लक्षणों का संचरण)
164.example: DNA is the chemical basis of heredity and carries the coded message for proteins.

164.english_meaning: Simple sugars that cannot be hydrolyzed into smaller carbohydrates.
164.hindi_meaning: मोनोसैकेराइड (सरल शर्करा जो जल अपघटित नहीं होती)
164.example: Glucose and fructose are common examples of monosaccharides.

164.english_meaning: A covalent bond that joins a carbohydrate molecule to another group, which may or may not be another carbohydrate.
164.hindi_meaning: ग्लाइकोसाइडिक बंध (कार्बोहाइड्रेट इकाइयों को जोड़ने वाला बंध)
164.example: Two monosaccharides are joined together by an oxide linkage known as a glycosidic linkage.

164.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
164.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटन (जल के साथ रासायनिक प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा यौगिक का टूटना)
164.example: Sucrose undergoes hydrolysis to give D-glucose and D-fructose.

164.english_meaning: An insoluble polysaccharide consisting of beta-glucose units, forming the primary structural component of plant cell walls.
164.hindi_meaning: सेलूलोज़ (पादप कोशिका भित्ति का मुख्य घटक)
164.example: Cellulose is a straight-chain polysaccharide composed only of D-glucose units.

164.english_meaning: Substances or compounds added to a system to cause a chemical reaction.
164.example: What happens when D-glucose is treated with the following reagents?

164.english_meaning: To mention a number of things one by one; to list or specify.
164.hindi_meaning: एक-एक करके गिनना या उल्लेख करना
164.example: Enumerate the reactions of D-glucose which cannot be explained by its open chain structure.

164.english_meaning: A process in which proteins lose their tertiary and secondary structure by application of external stress or compound.
164.hindi_meaning: विकृतीकरण (प्रोटीन की संरचना का नष्ट होना)
164.example: Denaturation causes proteins to lose their biological activity.

164.english_meaning: Able to react both as a base and as an acid.
164.hindi_meaning: उभयधर्मी (जो अम्ल और क्षार दोनों रूप में व्यवहार करे)
164.example: How do you explain the amphoteric behaviour of amino acids?

164.english_meaning: The change of a liquid to a thickened or solid state, especially of blood.
164.example: Name the vitamin responsible for the coagulation of blood.

164.english_meaning: Combining in such a way as to enhance or emphasize each other's qualities, such as base pairs in DNA.
164.hindi_meaning: पूरक (एक-दूसरे के अनुकूल या मेल खाने वाले)
164.example: The two strands in DNA are not identical but are complementary.

164.english_meaning: A compound commonly found in DNA and RNA, consisting of a purine or pyrimidine base linked to a sugar.
164.hindi_meaning: न्यूक्लियोसाइड (शर्करा और बेस से बना अणु जिसमें फॉस्फेट नहीं होता)
164.example: What is the difference between a nucleoside and a nucleotide?

49.english_meaning: Containing more than one halogen atom in a chemical compound.
49.hindi_meaning: बहु-हैलोजनयुक्त (एक से अधिक हैलोजन परमाणु युक्त यौगिक)
49.example: Polyhalogen compounds are widely used in various industrial and agricultural applications.

49.english_meaning: A liquid substance capable of dissolving other substances.
49.hindi_meaning: विलायक (वह पदार्थ जो किसी अन्य पदार्थ को घोल सके)
49.example: Dichloromethane is widely used as a solvent in the manufacturing of drugs.

49.english_meaning: A gas or substance used to force out the contents of an aerosol can or container.
49.hindi_meaning: नोदक या दाब उत्पन्न करने वाला गैस/पदार्थ
49.example: Methylene chloride is used as a propellant in aerosols.
Exposure to lower levels of methylene chloride can lead to impaired hearing and vision.

49.english_meaning: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.
49.hindi_meaning: मितली या उल्टी जैसा महसूस होना
49.example: Higher levels of exposure to the chemical cause dizziness and nausea.

49.english_meaning: The transparent layer forming the front of the eye.
49.example: Direct contact of the chemical with the eyes can burn the cornea.

49.english_meaning: A substance that induces insensitivity to pain.
49.hindi_meaning: निश्चेतक (दर्द या चेतना शून्य करने की दवा)
49.example: Chloroform was once used as a general anaesthetic in surgery.

49.english_meaning: Persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.
49.example: Chronic chloroform exposure may cause serious damage to the liver.

49.english_meaning: Processed by the body's chemical and physical chemical processes.
49.hindi_meaning: उपापचयित होना (शरीर द्वारा रासायनिक रूप से परिवर्तित होना)
49.example: In the liver, chloroform is metabolised to phosgene.

49.english_meaning: A highly toxic gas, carbonyl chloride, formed by the oxidation of chloroform.
49.example: Chloroform is slowly oxidised by air to an extremely poisonous gas called phosgene.

49.english_meaning: Preventing the growth of disease-causing microorganisms.
49.example: Iodoform was used earlier as an antiseptic due to the liberation of free iodine.

49.english_meaning: The production of chemical compounds by reaction from simpler materials.
49.example: It is used as feedstock in the synthesis of chlorofluorocarbons.

49.english_meaning: Cleaning or removing grease or oil from a surface.
49.hindi_meaning: चिकनाई या तेल साफ करने वाला
49.example: It was widely used as a degreasing agent in industry.

49.english_meaning: A state of near-unconsciousness or insensibility.
49.example: In severe cases, exposure to the chemical can lead rapidly to stupor or coma.

49.english_meaning: Diminishes in quantity or power, exhausts.
49.example: When carbon tetrachloride is released into the air, it depletes the ozone layer.

148.english_meaning: Compounds with the same chemical formula but different structures or properties.
148.hindi_meaning: समावयवी (वे यौगिक जिनका रासायनिक सूत्र समान होता है लेकिन संरचना या गुण भिन्न होते हैं)
148.example: Glucose exists in different isomers such as the alpha-form and beta-form.

148.english_meaning: A type of stereoisomer that differ in configuration at the C1 carbon atom in cyclic sugars.
148.hindi_meaning: एनमर्स (स्टीरियोआइसमर्स का एक प्रकार जो चक्रीय शर्करा में C1 कार्बन परमाणु पर भिन्न होते हैं)
148.example: The alpha-form and beta-form of glucose are called anomers.

148.english_meaning: A carbohydrate having a six-membered cyclic structure containing five carbon atoms and one oxygen atom.
148.hindi_meaning: पाइरानोज़ (छह सदस्यीय चक्रीय संरचना वाला कार्बोहाइड्रेट जिसमें पांच कार्बन और एक ऑक्सीजन परमाणु होता है)
148.example: The six-membered cyclic structure of glucose is called pyranose structure.

148.english_meaning: A comparison between two things, typically on the basis of their structure for explanation.
148.example: The structure is named in analogy with pyran.

148.english_meaning: The chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water.
148.hindi_meaning: जलअपघटन (पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया के कारण किसी यौगिक का रासायनिक टूटना)
148.example: Fructose is obtained by the hydrolysis of disaccharide sucrose.

148.english_meaning: A sugar whose molecules consist of two monosaccharide units joined together.
148.hindi_meaning: डाइसैकेराइड (ऐसी शर्करा जिसके अणु दो मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों से मिलकर बने होते हैं)
148.example: Sucrose is a common disaccharide composed of glucose and fructose.

148.english_meaning: A simple sugar that cannot be hydrolyzed to give a simpler sugar.
148.hindi_meaning: मोनोसैकेराइड (सरल शर्करा जिसे जलअपघटित करके और सरल शर्करा नहीं प्राप्त की जा सकती)
148.example: Fructose is a natural monosaccharide found in fruits and honey.

148.english_meaning: A monosaccharide containing six carbon atoms and a ketone group.
148.hindi_meaning: कीटोहेक्सोज (छह कार्बन परमाणुओं और एक कीटोन समूह वाला मोनोसैकेराइड)
148.example: Fructose is an important ketohexose containing a ketonic functional group.

148.english_meaning: Causing the rotation of plane-polarized light to the left.
148.hindi_meaning: वामघूर्णक या वामावर्त घूर्णक (समतल-ध्रुवीकृत प्रकाश को बाईं ओर मोड़ने वाला)
148.example: Fructose belongs to the D-series and is a laevorotatory compound.

148.english_meaning: A cyclic sugar containing a five-membered ring with four carbon atoms and one oxygen atom.
148.hindi_meaning: फ्यूरानोज़ (चार कार्बन और एक ऑक्सीजन परमाणु वाले पांच सदस्यीय वलय युक्त चक्रीय शर्करा)
148.example: The five-membered ring of fructose is named as furanose.

148.english_meaning: The formation of a cyclic compound from a chain-like molecule.
148.hindi_meaning: चक्रीकरण (एक श्रृंखला जैसे अणु से चक्रीय यौगिक का निर्माण)
148.example: Anomers are formed during the cyclisation of glucose.

148.english_meaning: A substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements.
148.hindi_meaning: यौगिक (दो या दो से अधिक तत्वों के रासायनिक संयोजन से बना पदार्थ)
148.example: Pyran is a cyclic organic compound with one oxygen atom.

148.english_meaning: Relating to a specific group of atoms within a molecule responsible for characteristic reactions.
148.hindi_meaning: क्रियात्मक (अणु के भीतर परमाणुओं का वह समूह जो विशिष्ट प्रतिक्रियाओं के लिए जिम्मेदार हो)
148.example: Fructose contains a ketonic functional group at carbon number 2.

148.english_meaning: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.
148.example: The cyclic structure of glucose is represented by the Haworth structure.

148.english_meaning: Relating to or consisting of molecules.
148.example: Fructose also has the molecular formula C6H12O6.

163.english_meaning: A condition where the thyroid gland is underactive and produces insufficient hormones.
163.hindi_meaning: अवटु ग्रंथि की अल्पक्रियता (थायराइड हार्मोन की कमी से होने वाली स्थिति)
163.example: Low iodine levels in the diet can often lead to hypothyroidism.

163.english_meaning: A group of steroid hormones that regulate carbohydrate metabolism and stress responses.
163.hindi_meaning: ग्लूकोकॉर्टिकॉइड्स (कार्बोहाइड्रेट चयापचय को नियंत्रित करने वाले हार्मोन)
163.example: Glucocorticoids are essential for managing the body's inflammatory reactions.

163.english_meaning: The chemical processes that occur within a living organism in order to maintain life.
163.hindi_meaning: चयापचय (शरीर में होने वाली रासायनिक प्रक्रियाएं)
163.example: Regular exercise is known to boost your metabolism.

163.english_meaning: A condition characterized by an abnormally low level of blood sugar.
163.hindi_meaning: रक्त में शर्करा की कमी (लो ब्लड शुगर)
163.example: Addison's disease is often characterized by weakness and hypoglycemia.

163.english_meaning: The state of being likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing.
163.hindi_meaning: संवेदनशीलता या प्रवणता (किसी रोग या स्थिति के प्रति झुकाव)
163.example: Stress increases the body's susceptibility to various illnesses.

163.english_meaning: The attachment of the fertilized egg to the wall of the uterus.
163.example: Progesterone prepares the uterus for the implantation of the fertilized egg.

163.english_meaning: To break down a chemical compound by reaction with water.
163.hindi_meaning: जल-अपघटित (पानी के साथ प्रतिक्रिया द्वारा तोड़ना)
163.example: When starch is hydrolysed, it produces glucose.

163.english_meaning: Capable of rotating the plane of polarized light.
163.hindi_meaning: प्रकाशिक सक्रिय (जो ध्रुवित प्रकाश को घुमाने में सक्षम हो)
163.example: Carbohydrates are defined as optically active polyhydroxy aldehydes or ketones.

163.english_meaning: The simplest form of sugar that cannot be hydrolyzed into smaller carbohydrates.
163.example: Glucose and fructose are common examples of monosaccharides.

163.english_meaning: A type of covalent bond that joins a carbohydrate molecule to another group.
163.hindi_meaning: ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध (कार्बोहाइड्रेट अणुओं को जोड़ने वाला बंध)
163.example: Monosaccharides are held together by glycosidic linkages to form polysaccharides.

163.english_meaning: Substances that have a molecular structure consisting chiefly or entirely of a large number of similar units bonded together.
163.hindi_meaning: बहुलक (समान इकाइयों से बनी लंबी श्रृंखला)
163.example: Proteins are complex polymers made of amino acids.

163.english_meaning: The chemical bond formed between the carboxyl group of one amino acid and the amino group of another.
163.hindi_meaning: पेप्टाइड बंध (अमीनो एसिड को जोड़ने वाले रासायनिक बंध)
163.example: Amino acids are linked together by peptide bonds to form proteins.

163.english_meaning: The process in which proteins lose their structure and function due to external stress like heat or pH change.
163.hindi_meaning: विकृतीकरण (प्रोटीन की संरचना का नष्ट होना)
163.example: High temperatures cause the denaturation of proteins, making them inactive.

163.english_meaning: Substances, typically enzymes, that increase the rate of chemical reactions in living organisms.
163.hindi_meaning: जैव-उत्प्रेरक (जैविक अभिक्रियाओं की गति बढ़ाने वाले पदार्थ)
163.example: Enzymes act as biocatalysts to speed up metabolic reactions.

163.english_meaning: A lack or shortage of something, especially something essential to health.
163.example: A deficiency of vitamins can lead to various health disorders.
